decisions.reason: Its move from a general mention to its own page suggests performance at least meets aspirations for a core safety-footwear line, and the firm's size and product-development slack support retention.

Because it stayed only a website mention without stronger promotion, results likely look modest rather than outstanding, but as a low-risk complement to the footwear business the firm is still more likely to keep it than drop it.

This supportive insole appears to have only limited visible momentum, yet it fits the firm's bundled footwear-and-fit offering and a large established manufacturer can afford to continue such a complementary product while learning.
Having its own page in both years indicates sustained commitment and satisfactory market reception for an ergonomic safety-shoe series that closely matches the firm's innovation strategy.
The shift from a mention to a dedicated page points to improving results in a relevant protective-footwear niche, making continuation more likely than resource reallocation.
Repeated home-page placement plus a concrete customer-use result signal strong acceptance and learning benefits, so this moulded insole is very likely to stay on the market.
